machine: Flash (Vinay's Ubuntu box, ssh flash, 12 threads, qwen-test venv: python 3.14 + numpy 2.5.4 + tokenizers 0.23.3)

model_pair.matrices: embedding + 24 blocks x (attn.q/k/v/o_proj, mlp.gate/up/down_proj) = 169 delta matrices

probe_set.source: combined fresh probe items generated by Muse Spark (Meta Model API, muse-spark-1.3): the original 24 held-out items plus 72 new items from alien_sweep_heldout96_gen.py; the sweep never saw any of them during search, Stage 1, or Stage 2
probe_set.novelty_check_new72: no exact normalized prompt match and no token-set Jaccard >= 0.7 against the 24 Signet prompts OR the first 24 held-out prompts; the knowledge bucket's first draft had one prompt flagged (Jaccard 0.71, a Switzerland currency item), regenerated via the logged retry

validation_problems_first_attempt: prompt too close to an existing item (jaccard 0.71): 'The currency used in Switzerland is the'

method.configs: base (no delta), full_delta (Instruct weights), and factored_delta per recipe: uniform_rank32, mlp_behemoth_lite (byte-matched), mlp_behemoth (BYTE-UNFAIR reference only)
method.scoring: identical to Stage 2 and the original guard: chat-formatted prompt (Qwen default system line); target logprob = summed log-probability of the answer tokens; accuracy = first-token accuracy; gap_closed = (factored - base) / (full - base) on mean target logprob, computed separately for the combined 96 and each subset with that subset's own base/full references
method.forward_pass: the Stage 2 NumPy Qwen2.5 forward (alien_sweep_stage2.py), unchanged

verdict.byte_fair_headline_question: does mlp_behemoth_lite still beat uniform_rank32 on the combined 96 fresh items?

mlp_behemoth_reference_only.note: mlp_behemoth is BYTE-UNFAIR (over the uniform budget) and is reported as a reference only, never as the headline.
